answer: Edge-provenance timestamping resists sybils: every attestation edge records WHEN it formed, and trust weight discounts edges that all appeared in a single suspicious burst — the signature of a cluster minted at once. A reef of fakes wired together in one canyon of a moment shows a telltale synchronized edge-creation signal that organic trust, which accretes gradually, never shows. Weighting by edge-age diversity starves a cluster whose entire internal graph sprang up simultaneously, however dense it is.
